lead: GameStop / GME — The meme crowd answers its own obituary
smaller: PDD Holdings / PDD — Jack Ma salutes the rival closing on Alibaba
Long Treasury ETF / TLT — The bond bulls finally get paid
Birkenstock / BIRK — The IPO buyers finally walk back to even
why_lead: The strongest direct retail-attention evidence of the month: Reuters attributes GameStop's rally to retail traders (n0145) and Business Insider reports options bets on a 28% jump (n0144), both newly published 2023-11-29, with GME +20.46% to 16.25 USD (+29.48% over five sessions) the day after Roundhill said it would close its MEME ETF (n0625). AMC +7.01%, Robinhood +3.24%; zero-day options boom (n1587, n1581), short-interest screens (n1572), Robinhood's UK launch (n0817). Analog is the gamma-squeeze mechanism (no own-date headline names a past meme episode); smart money split between the crowd and Roundhill/dealers/JPMorgan caution (n0778, n0454); breaks on the options deadline, the 13.77 USD 20-session reference and AMC's -32.87% stamina gap.
why_smaller: PDD: newly published Jack Ma memo praising PDD (n0779) and PDD-on-verge-of-surpassing-Alibaba coverage (n0807), PDD +39.75% over 20 sessions versus Alibaba -2.70% on the day; Temu share gains (n0833). New ticker; distinct from the 2023-11-24 Alibaba item (founder share sales). China consumer slump (n0230) supplies the break.

TLT: the rates-pivot payoff, +10.83% over 20 sessions with the 10Y down 61 bps, on rate-cut chatter (n1911, n1893, n1849) and 0DTE TLT options (n1583); strong GDP revision (n1867) and Treasury supply doubts (n1903) supply the break. TLT last appeared on 2023-11-02.
Birkenstock: IPO buyers back to even (n0704) with product hype (n0855); the premium-versus-discount tension (n0545, n0387) and break-even selling supply the break. New ticker.
